audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer rated all seven rows Lissandra (7-8/10) while the content layer and packet levelChart both say Skill for Levels 1 through 5.
audit.why: Qiyana's element-empowered Q and her 7s Terrashape re-arm give her real early trades; Lissandra has no kill button before Frozen Tomb. The lane turns at 6, not at 1.
audit.corrected: phases[0..3].side to Skill at 5/10 with the whys rewritten to argue the even case. Levels 6 onward stay Lissandra.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer says she 'Edge-of-Ixtal dashes onto you'. Edge of Ixtal is a Q variant, not a dash.
audit.why: The dash onto a champion is Audacity (E), 11/10/9/8/7s at 650 range. Terrashape (W) is the 7s dash to a location that re-arms her element. Naming the wrong ability makes the cooldown advice untrackable.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text and mid now name Audacity (E) as the dash-in, and the cooldowns field carries both timers.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit, and the content layer twice credits Qiyana with a reset ('Get a Q reset', 'her passive reset').
audit.why: Royal Privilege reads: 'Qiyana's first basic attack or ability against each enemy deals bonus damage.' There is no cooldown or ability reset anywhere in her kit as given. The real timers that matter are Audacity 11s to 7s and Terrashape a flat 7s.
audit.corrected: Removed the reset claim from wants.foe[0] and from mid, and stated the real cooldowns.

audit.why: 53.39% over 1742 games supports FAVOURED at 4/10 overall even with the early rows even.

edits.before: You are the assassin's nightmare pick — root the dash, tomb the dive, and counter-kill the reset he no longer has.
edits.after: You are the assassin's nightmare pick — root the dash, tomb the dive, and counter-kill the element she no longer has.

edits.before: Qiyana wins by landing Audacity, denying your pattern, and cashing the all-in before your pattern matures.
edits.after: Qiyana wins by dashing Audacity out of a brush with an element banked, then stunning you into her own wall.

edits.before: Q-shatter his wave contact, and when he steps to punish, W-root into full rotation and walk — the root tax makes every aggressive step expensive.
edits.after: Q-shatter her wave contact, and when she takes Audacity in at 650, W-root into full rotation and walk — her dash is gone for 11s and she cannot leave.

edits.before: Clawing in with W on cooldown 'to poke' — an engage tool spent on chip damage is a Lissandra standing in melee range with no ice left.
edits.after: Clawing in with W on cooldown 'to poke' — Terrashape re-arms her element every 7s and a rootless Lissandra in melee just feeds the combo.
